habitat.name: alpine meadow
adjustments: dark back and light belly (strong countershading)
shorter ears and tail, dense coat for the cold
habitat.visible_trait: shorter ears and tail, dense coat for the cold

behavior.note: Follows head/brain donor per-trait decision: colonial, huddling and aquatic-foraging drive from host; movement limited by upright waddle

body.note: Per-trait host frame: upright deep-chested penguin torso with dense feathers; chimera edges only where cheetah patches meet, no blending inside

coat_color.note: Tawny base with black spots at full cheetah color inside patches only; surrounding plumage keeps host countershading, blend only at patch edges

coat_pattern.note: Few large cheetah spot blocks with clear edges, each block fully cheetah with no internal blending; layout follows host dorsal feather tracts at graft level

coat_texture.note: Short coarse cheetah fur at full strength inside patches; elsewhere dense host feathers; pattern GATE satisfied only where fur present

ears.note: Per-trait host decision: no external pinnae as in host, fully host tissue

face.note: Per-trait host decision: beaked face with host feathering, no cheetah muzzle tissue

feet.note: Per-trait host decision: webbed penguin feet for upright stance, fully host tissue

head.note: Per-trait host decision: feathered penguin head and beak; supplies brain tissue for behavior

limbs.note: Per-trait host decision: flipper-like forelimbs and short hindlegs, fully host tissue, no cheetah limb tissue

mane.note: absent: no hair on the neck

size.note: Per-trait host size: ~35kg upright host frame; cheetah patches scaled to fit host with no intermediate sizing

skull.note: Per-trait host decision: penguin skull and beak architecture supporting head/brain tissue

tail.note: Per-trait host decision: short stiff penguin tail wedge, fully host tissue

processes: chimera patchwork: each region is one parent's tissue

audit.detail: emperor penguin beak, carnivore: beak shape is never a reason to reject (it explains under 12 percent of diet)
moves on its arms and legs
cold habitat: shorter ears and tail, dense coat for the cold
emperor penguin head and eyes kept fully visible

transfers.anchor: the skin, as the host's own covering
transfers.extent_reason: plan regions: the donor covering is a surface patch, not a body system
transfers.scale: sized to the emperor penguin's body and following its contours
